artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:95:Pointer artifacts are themselves hash-addressed and replaced by publishing new pointer objects. They may name a current pack, but they do not change pack bytes.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:99:Immutable pack objects are long-cache candidates because their path includes version and hash. Manifest, freshness, revocation, compatibility, and rollback objects are short-cache candidates because they encode current selection and safety state.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:104:- Current manifests, revocation lists, freshness manifests, compatibility tables, and rollback manifests use short TTLs.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:105:- Runtime reads manifest first, then exact pack path.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:106:- A changed current manifest points to a new path, not a mutated pack.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:107:- Quarantined or revoked paths are retained only for local audit/receipt behavior when safe and must not drive current recommendations.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:113:- released pack body changes without path change
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:114:- version changes without release receipt

artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:116:- supersession without reason, effective date, replacement target, and release receipt
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:117:- runtime eligibility from a pack that lacks source binding, freshness, revocation, release receipt, rollback, and compatibility proof
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:118:- private user data in any path, object body, metadata, manifest, validation report, release receipt, request, log, screenshot, or support artifact
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:122:If a released pack is bad, the repair path is:
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:124:1. Publish a revocation or rollback manifest that names the bad artifact id, version, and sha256.
artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_IMMUTABLE_PACK_PATH_STRATEGY.md:126:3. Publish a new current manifest that points to the replacement or last-known-good path.

artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_FRESHNESS_REVOCATION_MANIFESTS.md:93:- A new revocation manifest invalidates cached eligibility for matching packs, claims, sources, signers, manifests, paths, and hashes.

artifacts/source-atlas-factory/r2/R2_FRESHNESS_REVOCATION_MANIFESTS.md:95:- Offline use may rely on a verified last-known-good pack only when its freshness window allows offline grace, it is not hard-expired, and no cached revocation blocks it.

artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:109:## R2 Boundary Rules
artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:111:1. R2 may store only public, non-user-specific Source Atlas/source/pathing material and release/control metadata.
artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:112:2. R2 must not store, receive, infer, derive, personalize from, or log private user life data.
artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:113:3. R2 objects must be reusable ingredients, not exact-user plans, schedules, proof histories, receipts, replays, or local learning.
artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:114:4. R2 fetch requests must not include raw user goals, captures, schedule context, proof, receipt ids, replay ids, user profile, behavioral patterns, or user-identifying life graph state.
artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:115:5. R2 material can become runtime-eligible only after later Source Atlas phases prove source binding, hash/signature, freshness, revocation, review, rollback, high-risk boundaries, and local fallback.
artifacts/personal-life-os/reports/PLOS-025-r2-source-only-boundary-matrix.md:116:6. R2 cannot be used as Ambitions personal data storage, backup, sync, diagnostics, telemetry, analytics, or cloud learning.
